title: Monastery secrets (GM-only)
_note: GM / discovery-only truths for the rare secret house (phase-15 §2.7). This is NEVER rendered in the player-facing panel — the surface always reads as a wholesome, welcoming house; the secret is surfaced only by exploring the catacombs or via a GM reveal control. Keep it out of any player-visible model.

entries.value: the abbot is not what he seems
a thing lies sealed in the deepest crypt
the order worships an older, darker power
the wine is pressed from more than grapes
the brothers feed what breeds in the catacombs
the whole house is a lure for travellers
the incorrupt saint below is only sleeping
the choir sings to keep something beneath asleep
no novice who enters is ever seen to leave
the relic they venerate is a fetter, and it is loosening
the founder never died, and still gives orders
the library hides one book that should have been burned
the monks are the last of a heresy the church thinks extinct
beneath the altar runs a road to somewhere that is not here
the well water grants visions, and the order drinks deep
every seventh brother wears another brother's face
the bells were cast to bind a thing, and one has cracked
the guest-house feeds its visitors to what sleeps below
the order keeps a prisoner none of them will name
the relics in the crypt are still warm
the abbot's confessor has no reflection
the harvest fails unless the old rite is kept in the dark
